data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Quality of this piece is great](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a5509dc71aef0e3b72c293a)
Quality of the pieces are great - I got a vase and it's heavy, sturdy, and has a nice felt bottom. The curves and folds look beautiful from different angles. The only reason this gets 4 instead of 5 stars is because in the promo images the color is more of an aqua/green undertoned blue. In reality it is a more grey undertone - it still works in my space but it's not 100% true to the images.

July 6, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Jul 13, 2026

Hi Acacia,

We are so glad to hear you appreciate the quality, and design of your new vase! We understand your feedback regarding the color variation from our promotional images to the actual product. We are always working to ensure our product images accurately represents our items, and we appreciate you bringing this to our attention.

Lulu and Georgia
